name: Request Group Information 1
definition: Set of characteristics that unambiguously identify the global invoice financing request.

GroupIdentification.name: Group Identification
GroupIdentification.definition: Point to point reference assigned by the financing requestor to unambiguously identify the invoice financing request message.||Usage: The financing requestor has to make sure that 'GroupIdentification' is unique for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time on which the invoice financing request was created.

Authorisation.name: Authorisation
Authorisation.definition: User identification or any user key that allows to check if the financing requestor is allowed to ask for invoice financing.||Usage: the content is not of a technical nature, but reflects the organisational structure at the requesting side.|The authorisation element can typically be used in case the financing requestor acts on behalf of one or more suppliers.

NumberOfInvoiceRequests.name: Number Of Invoice Requests
NumberOfInvoiceRequests.definition: Specifies the number of single invoice financing requests included in the bulk request message.

TotalBulkInvoiceAmount.name: Total Bulk Invoice Amount
TotalBulkInvoiceAmount.definition: Total amount of the bulk invoice financing request. It is composed by the sum of the total amounts of all invoices included in the financing request.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Reference currency of the invoice financing request.

FinancingAgreement.name: Financing Agreement
FinancingAgreement.definition: Specifies the financing method related to invoice financing (eg collection mandate).

FinancingRequestor.name: Financing Requestor
FinancingRequestor.definition: Party that requests the invoice financing, on behalf of a creditor.

IntermediaryAgent.name: Intermediary Agent
IntermediaryAgent.definition: Financial institution that receives the request from the financing requestor and forwards it to the first agent for execution.

FirstAgent.name: First Agent
FirstAgent.definition: Financial institution of financing requestor to which an invoice financing request is addressed.

AgreementClauses.name: Agreement Clauses
AgreementClauses.definition: Agreements between financing requestor and his bank concerning conditions about the service of invoice financing, based on specific contractual schemes.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the financing request.
